fields.helpText: Keywords are used to search for drives on RCB.org. Maximum 50 characters, not required to be unique; not case sensitive; excludes numbers; 'and', 'or', 'left', 'right' as standalone words; special characters.

Keywords should begin by being letter based. They may have numbers after words; i.e. Bulldog2018, not 2018Bulldog

Keywords should not allow special characters (*&?%)
